message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a light blue background. At the top, black text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS KISAH SUKSES PEKERJA MIGRAN" above the large, white, partially obscured word "TEMPO". Small white text beneath reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". On the left, large black text says "WASWAS PERKARA LAWAS" above a smaller paragraph of black text beginning with "KPK membuka kembali...".

The central figure is a vertical stack of three human heads emerging from a single oversized, light-brown, wrinkled garment. The top head, a man with gray hair and glasses, looks upward with a rounded mouth, his hands positioned near his chest in a heart-shaped gesture. Below him, two additional male faces peek out from vertical slits in the garment’s torso. The lowest part of the figure consists of a single pair of legs wearing dark trousers and black shoes. 

A barcode at the bottom left is accompanied by numbers and text including "1-7 MEI 2017", "RP 45.000", and "ISSN 0126-4273". A solid red vertical bar runs down the far-left edge.
